donghe.name: Donghe
donghe.blurb: River-mouth point, Jinzun harbour beach and Chenggong to the north.

jukdo.name: Jukdo
jukdo.blurb: Korea's surf capital: a small beach between rocky points with peaks at both ends; best on northeast and east swells, autumn to spring.

cloud9.name: Cloud 9
cloud9.blurb: The Philippines' best-known wave, a thick, hollow right over shallow reef at the end of a boardwalk; best on typhoon swells from September to November.

zh.name: 九號雲
zh.region: 北蘇里高省 錫亞高島

ja.name: クラウド9
ja.full: クラウド9（シアルガオ島）
ja.region: 北スリガオ州 シアルガオ島

cheungsha.name: Cheung Sha
cheungsha.blurb: A long sand beach on Lantau's south coast and Hong Kong's summer spot; best from May to September in a south to southwest or typhoon swell with a north wind. Hong Kong has enforced its ban on surfing at public beaches, this one included, since 2024.

ja.name: チョンサー
ja.full: 下長沙ビーチ（ランタオ島）

dadonghai.name: Dadonghai
dadonghai.blurb: Sanya's town beach, a sandy bay below the Luhuitou headland; it needs a southeast to south swell, which mostly comes with typhoons from May to October, and a north wind offshore.

mykhe.name: My Khe
mykhe.blurb: Da Nang's main surf beach, the most consistent stretch of the city's long strand: soft peaks over sandbars that work on every tide, with surf schools and board rentals on the sand; best from September to March, peaking September to November, with a west wind offshore.

ja.name: ミーケー
ja.full: ミーケービーチ（ダナン）

nonnuoc.name: Non Nuoc
nonnuoc.blurb: The middle of Da Nang's long beach, below the Marble Mountains: sandbar peaks a little punchier than My Khe's but more open to the wind; best from September to March on a northeast swell, with a west-southwest wind offshore.

ja.name: ノンヌオック
ja.full: ノンヌオックビーチ（ダナン）

anbang.name: An Bang
anbang.blurb: Hoi An's beach, at the south end of the long Da Nang strand: a very shallow shelf with soft, mushy waves for beginners; best from September to March on a northeast swell.

ja.name: アンバン
ja.full: アンバンビーチ（ホイアン）
ja.region: ダナン市 ホイアン

quynhon.name: Quy Nhon
quynhon.blurb: A long city beach in a bay behind the Phuong Mai peninsula, with a tiny surf scene: fun, playful peaks on a strong northeast push or a typhoon swell, soft the rest of the time; best from September to March.

ja.name: クイニョン
ja.region: ザライ省 クイニョン

honchong.name: Hon Chong
honchong.blurb: Nha Trang's best surf, where the city's north beach meets the Hon Chong rocks: a beach break for learners inside and reef take-offs outside, including a fast left that likes size; best from November to March, with a west wind offshore.

ja.name: ホンチョン
ja.full: ホンチョンビーチ（ニャチャン）
ja.region: カインホア省 ニャチャン

baidai.name: Bai Dai
baidai.blurb: A long white-sand beach between Nha Trang and Cam Ranh's airport: uncrowded peaks that can work all year and stay clean in a west wind, straight offshore; best from November to March on east-northeast swells.

ja.name: バイダイ
ja.full: バイダイビーチ（カムラン）
ja.region: カインホア省 カムラン

muine.name: Mui Ne
muine.blurb: Vietnam's kitesurfing capital and one of its best surf towns: soft beach-break peaks on the main beach northeast of the fishing village, glassy only at dawn before the wind; best from November to March on an east swell.

ja.name: ムイネー
ja.full: ムイネービーチ（ファンティエット）
ja.region: ラムドン省 ムイネー

vungtau.name: Vung Tau
vungtau.region: Vung Tau, Ho Chi Minh City
vungtau.blurb: Saigon's weekend surf: Back Beach catches more swell than the sheltered Front Beach, with small, often inconsistent waves for beginners and longboarders; best from November to March in the northeast monsoon.

ja.name: ブンタウ
ja.full: ブンタウ・バックビーチ
ja.region: ホーチミン市 ブンタウ
